description: Manage local or independently hosted MCP servers. install adds a bundled catalog entry, enable re-enables a configured server, authorize runs its OAuth. Pass server names in connectors. Use this tool instead of hand-editing mcp_servers. Existing approval and authorization flows apply. When no card is available, show any authorization link to the user; never open it yourself. Do not repeat skipped or timed-out requests unless the user asks again. Connected tools are listed in the result and can be used through tool_describe/tool_call.
name: manage_connections
